Part of the analysis code for the matched liver–serum multi-omics study in MASLD. This script is self-contained: open it in RStudio (or `rmarkdown::render("Fig3_external_validation.Rmd")` from this folder). It first loads the workspace of the previous step (`Fig2_serum_metabolome`), running that script if needed. Input data are read from `data/` (see `data/README.md`); Supplementary Tables used here are in `Source_data/`; Source Data for this item are written to `Source_data/`; other outputs go to `results/`.

# External validation: Fig. 3 and Tables S5-S9

Discovery signatures in independent cohorts. Liver transcriptome: GSE162694 and GSE135251 (primary, and sensitivity analysis adjusted for sex inferred from expression); replication requires FDR <= 0.05 in both cohorts. Liver lipidome: ST000915.

## Discovery results under the names used by the validation chunks

```{r external-01, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# The validation chunks below compare each external cohort with the discovery DESeq2 results
# (same model as Table S1: ~ age + BMI + sex + trait, genes with >= 10 reads in >= 10 samples)
resLFC_steatosis    <- as.data.frame(disc_res$Steatosis)
resLFC_inflammation <- as.data.frame(disc_res$Inflammation)
resLFC_fibrosis     <- as.data.frame(disc_res$Fibrosis)
```

#### GSE162694

```{r external-02}
# ============================================================
# FULL PIPELINE: GSE162694 EXTERNAL VALIDATION
# DESeq2 DEGs -> FDR ≤ 0.05 (both discovery & validation)
# KEGG enrichment -> FDR ≤ 0.10
# Panel D: KEGG Count >= 3, faceted by KEGG Category,
#          colored by Direction (Up = #ffa500ff, Down = #4575B4)
# ============================================================
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. PACKAGES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
required_packages <- c(
  "GEOquery","DESeq2","dplyr","stringr","ggplot2",
  "clusterProfiler","org.Hs.eg.db","AnnotationDbi","enrichplot",
  "ggrepel","tidyr","patchwork","ggvenn","scales","viridis","cowplot",
  "KEGGREST"
)
for (p in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
}
library(GEOquery)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(ggvenn)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(KEGGREST)
# ============================================================
# GLOBAL THRESHOLDS
# ============================================================
FDR_DESEQ  <- 0.05   # DESeq2 DEG significance (discovery AND validation)
FDR_KEGG   <- 0.10   # KEGG enrichment significance
MIN_COUNT  <- 3       # Minimum gene count per KEGG term for plotting
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. PHENOTYPE DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gse162694   <- getGEO("GSE162694", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
eset_162694 <- gse162694[[1]]
pheno_raw   <- pData(eset_162694)
get_col <- function(df, pattern) {
  idx <- grep(pattern, colnames(df), ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(idx) == 0) {
    stop("No column found matching pattern: ", pattern)
  }
  if (length(idx) > 1) idx <- idx[1]
  df[[idx]]
}
pheno <- data.frame(
  GSM   = pheno_raw$geo_accession,
  Title = pheno_raw$title,
  Sex_raw       = tryCatch(get_col(pheno_raw, "^sex"),     error = function(e) NA),
  Age_raw       = tryCatch(get_col(pheno_raw, "^age"),     error = function(e) NA),
  Fibrosis_raw  = tryCatch(get_col(pheno_raw, "fibrosis"), error = function(e) NA),
  NAS_raw       = tryCatch(get_col(pheno_raw, "nas"),      error = function(e) NA),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rownames(pheno) <- pheno$GSM
pheno$Sex <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("female|^f$", pheno$Sex_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Female",
  grepl("male|^m$",   pheno$Sex_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Male",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
pheno$Sex <- factor(pheno$Sex, levels = c("Female","Male"))
pheno$Age <- as.numeric(str_extract(pheno$Age_raw, "[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*"))
pheno$Fibrosis_stage <- str_extract(pheno$Fibrosis_raw, "[0-9]+")
pheno$Fibrosis_stage[grepl("normal|control|none", pheno$Fibrosis_raw, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "0"
pheno$Fibrosis_stage <- as.numeric(pheno$Fibrosis_stage)
pheno$NAS_score <- as.numeric(str_extract(pheno$NAS_raw, "[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*"))
cat("\n===== METADATA CHECK =====\n")
cat("Samples:", nrow(pheno), "\n")
print(table(pheno$Sex, useNA = "ifany"))
print(summary(pheno$Age))
print(table(pheno$Fibrosis_stage, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(pheno$NAS_score, useNA = "ifany"))
if (all(is.na(pheno$Sex)) || all(is.na(pheno$Age))) {
  stop("Sex/Age extraction failed — inspect Sex_raw/Age_raw manually.")
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DOWNLOAD RAW COUNTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
supp_dir <- "GSE162694"
if (!dir.exists(supp_dir) || length(list.files(supp_dir)) == 0) {
  getGEOSuppFiles("GSE162694", makeDirectory = TRUE, baseDir = ".")
}
supp_files <- list.files(supp_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
count_file <- supp_files[grepl("count", supp_files, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
if (is.na(count_file)) stop("No count file found. Files present:\n", paste(supp_files, collapse="\n"))
cat("\nUsing count file:", count_file, "\n")
count_df <- if (grepl("\\.csv", count_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  read.csv(count_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  read.delim(count_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
gene_ids <- count_df[[1]]
count_mat_raw <- as.matrix(count_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat_raw) <- "numeric"
rownames(count_mat_raw) <- sub("\\..*$", "", gene_ids)
count_mat_raw <- count_mat_raw[!is.na(rownames(count_mat_raw)) & rownames(count_mat_raw) != "", , drop = FALSE]
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. MATCH SAMPLES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
count_sample_key <- str_extract(colnames(count_mat_raw), "548nash[0-9]+")
pheno$SampleKey   <- str_extract(pheno$Title, "548nash[0-9]+")
common_keys <- intersect(count_sample_key, pheno$SampleKey)
common_keys <- common_keys[!is.na(common_keys)]
if (length(common_keys) == 0) stop("No samples matched between counts and phenotype.")
count_idx <- match(common_keys, count_sample_key)
pheno_idx <- match(common_keys, pheno$SampleKey)
counts_all <- count_mat_raw[, count_idx, drop = FALSE]
pheno_all  <- pheno[pheno_idx, , drop = FALSE]
colnames(counts_all) <- pheno_all$GSM
rownames(pheno_all)  <- pheno_all$GSM
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_all), rownames(pheno_all)))
cat("Matched:", ncol(counts_all), "samples,", nrow(counts_all), "genes\n")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DEFINE PHENOTYPE GROUPS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pheno_all$Fibrosis <- factor(
  ifelse(pheno_all$Fibrosis_stage == 0, "F0", "F1_F4"),
  levels = c("F0","F1_F4")
)
cat("\nFibrosis groups:\n"); print(table(pheno_all$Fibrosis, useNA = "ifany"))
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. FIBROSIS DESeq2 (Sex + Age adjusted), FDR = 0.05
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fib_ok <- complete.cases(pheno_all$Fibrosis, pheno_all$Sex, pheno_all$Age)
pheno_fib_de <- pheno_all[fib_ok, , drop = FALSE]
counts_fib   <- counts_all[, rownames(pheno_fib_de), drop = FALSE]
pheno_fib_de$Age_z <- as.numeric(scale(pheno_fib_de$Age))
keep_fib <- rowSums(counts_fib >= 10) >= 10
counts_fib <- counts_fib[keep_fib, , drop = FALSE]
cat("\nGenes retained (fibrosis):", nrow(counts_fib), " | Samples:", ncol(counts_fib), "\n")
dds_fib <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_fib),
  colData   = pheno_fib_de,
  design    = ~ Sex + Age_z + Fibrosis
)
dds_fib <- DESeq(dds_fib)
fibrosis_coef <- grep("^Fibrosis_", resultsNames(dds_fib), value = TRUE)
res_fib_external    <- results(dds_fib, name = fibrosis_coef, alpha = FDR_DESEQ)
resLFC_fib_external <- lfcShrink(dds_fib, coef = fibrosis_coef, type = "apeglm")
res_fib_external    <- res_fib_external[!is.na(res_fib_external$padj), ]
resLFC_fib_external <- resLFC_fib_external[!is.na(resLFC_fib_external$padj), ]
fib_ext_up   <- rownames(subset(resLFC_fib_external, padj <= FDR_DESEQ & log2FoldChange > 0))
fib_ext_down <- rownames(subset(resLFC_fib_external, padj <= FDR_DESEQ & log2FoldChange < 0))
cat("\n=== GSE162694 FIBROSIS (FDR<", FDR_DESEQ, ") ===\n")
cat("Total DEGs:", length(c(fib_ext_up, fib_ext_down)),
   " UP:", length(fib_ext_up), " DOWN:", length(fib_ext_down), "\n")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. NAS DESeq2 (Sex + Age adjusted), FDR = 0.05
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nas_ok <- complete.cases(pheno_all$NAS_score, pheno_all$Sex, pheno_all$Age)
pheno_nas_de <- pheno_all[nas_ok, , drop = FALSE]
counts_nas   <- counts_all[, rownames(pheno_nas_de), drop = FALSE]
pheno_nas_de$Age_z <- as.numeric(scale(pheno_nas_de$Age))
keep_nas <- rowSums(counts_nas >= 10) >= 10
counts_nas <- counts_nas[keep_nas, , drop = FALSE]
cat("\nGenes retained (NAS):", nrow(counts_nas), " | Samples:", ncol(counts_nas), "\n")
dds_nas <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_nas),
  colData   = pheno_nas_de,
  design    = ~ Sex + Age_z + NAS_score
)
dds_nas <- DESeq(dds_nas)
nas_coef <- grep("NAS_score", resultsNames(dds_nas), value = TRUE)
res_nas_external    <- results(dds_nas, name = nas_coef, alpha = FDR_DESEQ)
resLFC_nas_external <- lfcShrink(dds_nas, coef = nas_coef, type = "apeglm")
res_nas_external    <- res_nas_external[!is.na(res_nas_external$padj), ]
resLFC_nas_external <- resLFC_nas_external[!is.na(resLFC_nas_external$padj), ]
nas_up   <- rownames(subset(resLFC_nas_external, padj <= FDR_DESEQ & log2FoldChange > 0))
nas_down <- rownames(subset(resLFC_nas_external, padj <= FDR_DESEQ & log2FoldChange < 0))
cat("\n=== GSE162694 NAS score (FDR<", FDR_DESEQ, ") ===\n")
cat("Total:", length(c(nas_up, nas_down)),
   " UP:", length(nas_up), " DOWN:", length(nas_down), "\n")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. VST for downstream use (PCA)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
dds_vst_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(counts_all),
                                      colData = pheno_all, design = ~1)
dds_vst_all <- DESeq(dds_vst_all)
vsd_all     <- vst(dds_vst_all, blind = TRUE)
exp_val_all <- t(assay(vsd_all))
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. DEG COMPARISON FUNCTION (Discovery vs Validation), FDR = 0.05 both sides
# ------------------------------------------------------------
validate_signature <- function(discovery, external, label, fdr = FDR_DESEQ) {
  disc_sig <- rownames(subset(discovery, !is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr))
  ext_sig  <- rownames(subset(external,  !is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr))
  overlap  <- intersect(disc_sig, ext_sig)
  x <- discovery[overlap, "log2FoldChange"]
  y <- external[overlap, "log2FoldChange"]
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  overlap <- overlap[ok]; x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  same_direction <- sign(x) == sign(y)
  cat("\n====================================\n", label, "\n")
  cat("Discovery significant:", length(disc_sig), "\n")
  cat("External significant:", length(ext_sig), "\n")
  cat("Overlap:", length(overlap), "\n")
  if (length(overlap) > 1) {
    rho <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman")
    binom <- binom.test(sum(same_direction), length(same_direction),
                        p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")
    cat("Spearman rho:", round(unname(rho$estimate), 3), "\n")
    cat("Spearman P:", format.pval(rho$p.value, digits = 4), "\n")
    cat("Same direction:", round(100 * mean(same_direction), 2), "%\n")
    cat("Binomial P:", format.pval(binom$p.value, digits = 4), "\n")
  }
  cat("====================================\n")
  invisible(list(genes = overlap, discovery_lfc = x, external_lfc = y,
                same_direction = same_direction))
}
validation_fibrosis <- validate_signature(
  resLFC_fibrosis, resLFC_fib_external, "FIBROSIS: Discovery vs GSE162694", fdr = FDR_DESEQ)
validation_steatosis <- validate_signature(
  resLFC_steatosis, resLFC_nas_external, "STEATOSIS vs GSE162694 NAS", fdr = FDR_DESEQ)
validation_inflammation <- validate_signature(
  resLFC_inflammation, resLFC_nas_external, "INFLAMMATION vs GSE162694 NAS", fdr = FDR_DESEQ)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. KEGG ENRICHMENT FUNCTION, FDR = 0.10
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_kegg_external <- function(res, direction = c("up","down"), fdr_deg = FDR_DESEQ, fdr_kegg = FDR_KEGG) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  genes <- if (direction == "up") {
    rownames(subset(res, !is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr_deg & log2FoldChange > 0))
  } else {
    rownames(subset(res, !is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr_deg & log2FoldChange < 0))
  }
  background <- rownames(res)
  genes <- unique(genes[grepl("^ENSG", genes)])
  background <- unique(background[grepl("^ENSG", background)])
  if (length(genes) < 5) return(NULL)
  gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = genes,
                                    keytype = "ENSEMBL", columns = "ENTREZID")
  background_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = background,
                                          keytype = "ENSEMBL", columns = "ENTREZID")
  gene_map <- gene_map[!is.na(gene_map$ENTREZID), ]
  background_map <- background_map[!is.na(background_map$ENTREZID), ]
  ek <- enrichKEGG(gene = unique(gene_map$ENTREZID),
                   universe = unique(background_map$ENTREZID),
                   organism = "hsa",
                   pvalueCutoff = fdr_kegg,
                   qvalueCutoff = fdr_kegg)
  ek
}
kegg_fib_ext_up   <- run_kegg_external(resLFC_fib_external, "up")
kegg_fib_ext_down <- run_kegg_external(resLFC_fib_external, "down")
kegg_nas_ext_up   <- run_kegg_external(resLFC_nas_external, "up")
kegg_nas_ext_down <- run_kegg_external(resLFC_nas_external, "down")

report_pathway_overlap <- function(disc_kegg, ext_kegg, label) {
  if (is.null(disc_kegg) || is.null(ext_kegg)) return(invisible(NULL))
  overlap <- intersect(disc_kegg@result$ID, ext_kegg@result$ID)
  cat("\n====", label, "====\n")
  cat("Overlapping pathways:", length(overlap), "\n")
  if (length(overlap) > 0) {
    print(disc_kegg@result[match(overlap, disc_kegg@result$ID), c("ID","Description")])
  }
}
report_pathway_overlap(ekegg_up_fibrosis,   kegg_fib_ext_up,   "FIBROSIS UP PATHWAY REPLICATION")
report_pathway_overlap(ekegg_down_fibrosis, kegg_fib_ext_down, "FIBROSIS DOWN PATHWAY REPLICATION")
report_pathway_overlap(ekegg_up_steatosis,   kegg_nas_ext_up,   "STEATOSIS UP / NAS UP SUPPORT")
report_pathway_overlap(ekegg_down_steatosis, kegg_nas_ext_down, "STEATOSIS DOWN / NAS DOWN SUPPORT")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
disc_fib_up   <- rownames(subset(resLFC_fibrosis, !is.na(padj) & padj <= FDR_DESEQ & log2FoldChange > 0))

write.csv(pheno_all, "GSE162694_metadata_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
#          PUBLICATION-QUALITY VALIDATION FIGURE
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey20"),
    strip.text       = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold")
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PANEL A — LOG2FC CONCORDANCE SCATTER (Fibrosis), FDR = 0.05 both
# ------------------------------------------------------------
common_fib <- intersect(rownames(resLFC_fibrosis), rownames(resLFC_fib_external))
df_fib <- data.frame(
  Gene            = common_fib,
  Discovery_LFC   = resLFC_fibrosis[common_fib, "log2FoldChange"],
  Validation_LFC  = resLFC_fib_external[common_fib, "log2FoldChange"],
  Discovery_padj  = resLFC_fibrosis[common_fib, "padj"],
  Validation_padj = resLFC_fib_external[common_fib, "padj"]
) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      Discovery_padj <= FDR_DESEQ & Validation_padj <= FDR_DESEQ &
        sign(Discovery_LFC) == sign(Validation_LFC) ~ "Replicated (concordant)",
      Discovery_padj <= FDR_DESEQ & Validation_padj <= FDR_DESEQ &
        sign(Discovery_LFC) != sign(Validation_LFC) ~ "Discordant direction",
      Discovery_padj <= FDR_DESEQ ~ "Discovery-only",
      Validation_padj <= FDR_DESEQ ~ "Validation-only",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Replicated (concordant)","Discordant direction",
                                       "Discovery-only","Validation-only","Not significant"))
  )
rho_fib <- cor.test(df_fib$Discovery_LFC, df_fib$Validation_LFC, method = "spearman")
same_dir_fib <- mean(sign(df_fib$Discovery_LFC) == sign(df_fib$Validation_LFC)) * 100
label_genes <- df_fib %>% filter(Status == "Replicated (concordant)") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Discovery_LFC) + abs(Validation_LFC))) %>% head(10)
label_genes$Symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = label_genes$Gene,
                                            column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                                            multiVals = "first")
panel_A <- ggplot(df_fib, aes(x = Discovery_LFC, y = Validation_LFC)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = "#fddbc7", alpha = 0.25) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0, fill = "#d1e5f0", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Status, size = Status, alpha = Status)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#b2182b", fill = "#f4a582", linewidth = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = label_genes, aes(label = Symbol),
                           size = 3.4, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = 20,
                           box.padding = 0.5, segment.color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Replicated (concordant)" = "#b2182b",
    "Discordant direction"    = "#878787",
    "Discovery-only"          = "#4393c3",
    "Validation-only"         = "#f4a582",
    "Not significant"         = "grey80"
  )) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(3, 2.5, 1.8, 1.8, 0.8)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.95, 0.8, 0.6, 0.6, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Fibrosis: Discovery vs GSE162694 Replication",
    subtitle = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", round(rho_fib$estimate, 3),
                     ", P = ", format.pval(rho_fib$p.value, digits = 3),
                     "  |  Same direction = ", round(same_dir_fib, 1), "%",
                     "  |  DESeq2 FDR <= ", FDR_DESEQ),
    x = "log2FC — Discovery Cohort",
    y = "log2FC — GSE162694 (Validation)",
    color = "Gene status"
  ) +
  guides(size = "none", alpha = "none") +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PANEL B — VENN DIAGRAMS, FDR = 0.05 both cohorts
# ------------------------------------------------------------
disc_fib_sig  <- rownames(subset(resLFC_fibrosis, padj <= FDR_DESEQ))
val_fib_sig   <- rownames(subset(resLFC_fib_external, padj <= FDR_DESEQ))
disc_steat_sig <- rownames(subset(resLFC_steatosis, padj <= FDR_DESEQ))
disc_infl_sig  <- rownames(subset(resLFC_inflammation, padj <= FDR_DESEQ))
val_nas_sig    <- rownames(subset(resLFC_nas_external, padj <= FDR_DESEQ))
venn_fib_list   <- list("Discovery\nFibrosis" = disc_fib_sig, "GSE162694\nFibrosis" = val_fib_sig)
venn_steat_list <- list("Discovery\nSteatosis" = disc_steat_sig, "GSE162694\nNAS score" = val_nas_sig)
venn_infl_list  <- list("Discovery\nInflammation" = disc_infl_sig, "GSE162694\nNAS score" = val_nas_sig)
make_venn <- function(lst, title, fill_cols) {
  ggvenn(lst, fill_color = fill_cols, stroke_size = 0.6,
        set_name_size = 4, text_size = 5, show_percentage = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
         panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
venn_fib   <- make_venn(venn_fib_list,   "Fibrosis DEG Overlap (FDR ≤ 0.05)",     c("#b2182b","#4393c3"))
venn_steat <- make_venn(venn_steat_list, "Steatosis vs NAS Overlap (FDR ≤ 0.05)", c("#f4a582","#4393c3"))
venn_infl  <- make_venn(venn_infl_list,  "Inflammation vs NAS Overlap (FDR ≤ 0.05)", c("#92c5de","#4393c3"))
panel_B <- plot_grid(venn_fib, venn_steat, venn_infl, ncol = 3)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PANEL C — DIRECTIONAL REPLICATION SUMMARY, FDR = 0.05 both
# ------------------------------------------------------------
get_stats <- function(res_disc, res_val, fdr = FDR_DESEQ) {
  disc <- subset(res_disc, !is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr)
  val  <- subset(res_val,  !is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr)
  overlap <- intersect(rownames(disc), rownames(val))
  if (length(overlap) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(rho = NA, p = NA, pct_concordant = NA, n = length(overlap), binom_p = NA))
  }
  x <- res_disc[overlap, "log2FoldChange"]
  y <- res_val[overlap, "log2FoldChange"]
  rho <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman")
  same <- sign(x) == sign(y)
  binom <- binom.test(sum(same), length(same), p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")
  data.frame(rho = unname(rho$estimate), p = rho$p.value,
            pct_concordant = mean(same) * 100, n = length(overlap),
            binom_p = binom$p.value)
}
stats_fib   <- get_stats(resLFC_fibrosis, resLFC_fib_external)
stats_steat <- get_stats(resLFC_steatosis, resLFC_nas_external)
stats_infl  <- get_stats(resLFC_inflammation, resLFC_nas_external)
summary_df <- bind_rows(
  cbind(Trait = "Fibrosis vs Fibrosis", stats_fib),
  cbind(Trait = "Steatosis vs NAS", stats_steat),
  cbind(Trait = "Inflammation vs NAS", stats_infl)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = factor(Trait, levels = rev(c("Fibrosis vs Fibrosis","Steatosis vs NAS","Inflammation vs NAS"))),
    Significant = ifelse(!is.na(binom_p) & binom_p < 0.05, "Significant replication", "Not significant"),
    Label = paste0("n=", n, "  ρ=", round(rho, 2))
  )
panel_C <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = pct_concordant, y = Trait)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 50, xend = pct_concordant, y = Trait, yend = Trait, color = Significant),
              linewidth = 2.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n, color = Significant)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), vjust = -1.3, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant replication" = "#b2182b",
                                "Not significant" = "grey60")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 9), guide = "none") +
  xlim(30, 100) +
  labs(
    title = "Directional Replication Summary",
    subtitle = paste0("DESeq2 FDR <= ", FDR_DESEQ, " both cohorts | dashed line = chance level"),
    x = "% Same-Direction Genes (Discovery vs Validation)",
    y = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
# ============================================================
# PANEL D — KEGG PATHWAY REPLICATION
# Count >= 3 filter, faceted by KEGG Category,
# colored by Direction: Up = "#ffa500ff", Down = "#4575B4"
# ============================================================
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D1. Build combined discovery + validation KEGG table
#     for shared (replicated) pathways only
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_kegg_compare_df <- function(disc_kegg, ext_kegg, direction_label) {
  if (is.null(disc_kegg) || is.null(ext_kegg)) return(NULL)
  if (nrow(disc_kegg@result) == 0 || nrow(ext_kegg@result) == 0) return(NULL)
  shared <- intersect(disc_kegg@result$ID, ext_kegg@result$ID)
  if (length(shared) == 0) return(NULL)
  d <- disc_kegg@result %>% filter(ID %in% shared) %>%
    transmute(ID, Description, Cohort = "Discovery", p.adjust, Count)
  v <- ext_kegg@result %>% filter(ID %in% shared) %>%
    transmute(ID, Description, Cohort = "GSE162694", p.adjust, Count)
  bind_rows(d, v) %>% mutate(Direction = direction_label)
}
kegg_compare_up   <- build_kegg_compare_df(ekegg_up_fibrosis,   kegg_fib_ext_up,   "Up")
kegg_compare_down <- build_kegg_compare_df(ekegg_down_fibrosis, kegg_fib_ext_down, "Down")
kegg_compare_all  <- bind_rows(kegg_compare_up, kegg_compare_down)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D2. Filter Count >= MIN_COUNT (both cohort rows for a term must qualify)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!is.null(kegg_compare_all) && nrow(kegg_compare_all) > 0) {
  kegg_compare_all <- kegg_compare_all %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    filter(all(Count >= MIN_COUNT)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D3. Fetch KEGG Category (Main_Category) via KEGGREST
#     - same approach as your previous kegg_top pipeline
# ------------------------------------------------------------
get_kegg_category <- function(pathway_id) {
  info <- tryCatch(keggGet(pathway_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(info$CLASS)) {
    return(info$CLASS[1])
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}
if (!is.null(kegg_compare_all) && nrow(kegg_compare_all) > 0) {
  unique_ids <- unique(kegg_compare_all$ID)
  categories <- sapply(unique_ids, get_kegg_category)
  category_df <- data.frame(
    ID = unique_ids,
    Category = categories,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Main_Category = sapply(strsplit(Category, ";"), `[`, 1),
      Sub_Category  = sapply(strsplit(Category, ";"), `[`, 2)
    )
  # Manual override example (as in the original code)
  category_df$Main_Category[category_df$ID == "hsa04820"] <- "Cellular Processes"
  kegg_compare_all <- kegg_compare_all %>%
    left_join(category_df[, c("ID","Main_Category")], by = "ID") %>%
    mutate(Main_Category = ifelse(is.na(Main_Category), "Unclassified", Main_Category))
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D4. Build final Panel D plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!is.null(kegg_compare_all) && nrow(kegg_compare_all) > 0) {
  kegg_compare_all <- kegg_compare_all %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10p = -log10(p.adjust),
      Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description))),
      Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Up","Down"))
    )
  panel_D <- ggplot(kegg_compare_all, aes(x = Cohort, y = Description,
                                          size = neglog10p, color = Direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_grid(Main_Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#ffa500ff", "Down" = "#4575B4")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9), name = "-log10(FDR)") +
    labs(
      title = "Replicated KEGG Pathways (Fibrosis)",
      subtitle = paste0("Pathways significant in BOTH cohorts, KEGG FDR <= ", FDR_KEGG,
                        ", Count \u2265 ", MIN_COUNT),
      x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
} else {
  panel_D <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
            label = paste0("No overlapping KEGG pathways\n(Count \u2265 ", MIN_COUNT,
                          ") between cohorts at current thresholds"),
            size = 5, fontface = "italic") +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle("Replicated KEGG Pathways (Fibrosis)") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14))
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# COMBINE FINAL FIGURE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bottom_row <- plot_grid(panel_C, panel_D, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 1.3),
                        labels = c("C","D"), label_size = 18)
final_validation_figure <- plot_grid(
  panel_A,
  panel_B,
  bottom_row,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1.3, 0.9, 1.1),
  labels = c("A","B",""),
  label_size = 18
)
final_validation_figure
ggsave("Figure_Validation_GSE162694.png", final_validation_figure,
      width = 16, height = 15, dpi = 400, bg = "white")
ggsave("Figure_Validation_GSE162694.pdf", final_validation_figure,
      width = 16, height = 15, bg = "white")
# ---- after running the GSE162694 chunk ----

  label         = "GSE162694",
  fib_res       = as.data.frame(resLFC_fib_external),   # ENSG rownames
  nas_res       = as.data.frame(resLFC_nas_external),
  kegg_fib_up   = kegg_fib_ext_up,
  kegg_fib_down = kegg_fib_ext_down,
  kegg_nas_up   = kegg_nas_ext_up,
  kegg_nas_down = kegg_nas_ext_down
)
```

```{r external-03}
# GSE135251 EXTERNAL VALIDATION

# Steatosis     = 0 vs 1+2+3+4

# Inflammation  = supporting validation using NAS

  pheno$`fibrosis stage:ch1`
)
pheno$NAS_score <- as.numeric(
  pheno$`nas score:ch1`
)

  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)

  counts_df[,-1,drop=FALSE]

storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"

# ============================================================
# 3. MATCH COUNTS TO GEO

  colnames(counts),
  rownames(pheno)
)
if(length(common)>0){
  counts <- counts[,common,drop=FALSE]
  pheno <- pheno[common,,drop=FALSE]
} else {
  count_key <- gsub("\\s+","",colnames(counts))
  title_key <- gsub("\\s+","",pheno$title)
  idx <- match(count_key,title_key)
  keep <- !is.na(idx)
  counts <- counts[,keep,drop=FALSE]
  pheno <- pheno[idx[keep],,drop=FALSE]
  colnames(counts) <- rownames(pheno)
}
stopifnot(

# ============================================================
# 6. ENTRES -> ENSEMBL
# ============================================================
convert_entrez_to_ensembl <- function(res){
  map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys=rownames(res),
    keytype="ENTREZID",
    columns=c("ENSEMBL","SYMBOL")
  )
  map <- map[
    !is.na(map$ENSEMBL) &
      !duplicated(map$ENTREZID),
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  x <- as.data.frame(res)
  x$ENTREZID <- rownames(x)
  x$ENSEMBL <- map$ENSEMBL[
    match(
      x$ENTREZID,
      map$ENTREZID
    )
  ]
  x <- x[
    !is.na(x$ENSEMBL),
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  x <- x[
    !duplicated(x$ENSEMBL),
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  rownames(x) <- x$ENSEMBL
  x
}

fib_overlap <- intersect(

# ============================================================
# 13. KEGG
# ============================================================
run_kegg <- function(res,direction){
  genes <- if(direction=="up"){
    rownames(
      subset(
        res,
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj<=FDR_DEG &
          log2FoldChange>0
      )
    )
  } else {
    rownames(
      subset(
        res,
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj<=FDR_DEG &
          log2FoldChange<0
      )
    )
  }
  genes <- sub("\\..*$","",genes)
  genes <- unique(
    genes[grepl("^ENSG",genes)]
  )
  if(length(genes)<5)
    return(NULL)
  map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys=genes,
    keytype="ENSEMBL",
    columns="ENTREZID"
  )
  entrez <- unique(
    map$ENTREZID[
      !is.na(map$ENTREZID)
    ]
  )
  if(length(entrez)<5)
    return(NULL)
  ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene=entrez,
    organism="hsa",
    pvalueCutoff=FDR_PATH
  )
  if(is.null(ek))
    return(NULL)
  ek@result <- subset(
    ek@result,
    qvalue<=FDR_PATH
  )
  ek
}

get_stats <- function(
  res_disc,
  res_val,
  fdr=FDR_DESEQ
){
  disc <- subset(
    res_disc,
    !is.na(padj) & padj<=fdr
  )
  val <- subset(
    res_val,
    !is.na(padj) & padj<=fdr
  )
  overlap <- intersect(
    rownames(disc),
    rownames(val)
  )
  if(length(overlap)<2){
    return(
      data.frame(
        rho=NA,
        p=NA,
        pct_concordant=NA,
        n=length(overlap),
        binom_p=NA
      )
    )
  }
  x <- res_disc[
    overlap,
    "log2FoldChange"
  ]
  y <- res_val[
    overlap,
    "log2FoldChange"
  ]
  ok <- complete.cases(x,y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  rho <- cor.test(
    x,
    y,
    method="spearman"
  )
  same <- sign(x)==sign(y)
  binom <- binom.test(
    sum(same),
    length(same),
    p=0.5,
    alternative="greater"
  )
  data.frame(
    rho=unname(rho$estimate),
    p=rho$p.value,
    pct_concordant=mean(same)*100,
    n=length(same),
    binom_p=binom$p.value
  )
}

  resLFC_fibrosis,
  res_fib_ext_ens

build_kegg_compare_df <- function(
  disc_kegg,
  ext_kegg,
  direction_label
){
  if(
    is.null(disc_kegg) ||
    is.null(ext_kegg)
  )
    return(NULL)
  if(
    nrow(disc_kegg@result)==0 ||
    nrow(ext_kegg@result)==0
  )
    return(NULL)
  shared <- intersect(
    disc_kegg@result$ID,
    ext_kegg@result$ID
  )
  if(length(shared)==0)
    return(NULL)
  d <- disc_kegg@result %>%
    filter(ID %in% shared) %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      Description,
      Cohort="Discovery",
      p.adjust,
      Count
    )
  v <- ext_kegg@result %>%
    filter(ID %in% shared) %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      Description,
      Cohort="GSE135251",
      p.adjust,
      Count
    )
  bind_rows(d,v) %>%
    mutate(Direction=direction_label)
}

  ekegg_up_fibrosis,
  ext_kegg_fib_up,
  "Up"
)
kegg_compare_down <- build_kegg_compare_df(
  ekegg_down_fibrosis,
  ext_kegg_fib_down,
  "Down"
)

}

get_kegg_category <- function(pathway_id){
  info <- tryCatch(
    keggGet(pathway_id)[[1]],
    error=function(e) NULL
  )
  if(!is.null(info$CLASS))
    info$CLASS[1]
  else
    NA
}
if(
  nrow(kegg_compare_all)>0
){
  unique_ids <- unique(
    kegg_compare_all$ID
  )
  categories <- sapply(
    unique_ids,
    get_kegg_category
  )
  category_df <- data.frame(
    ID=unique_ids,
    Category=categories,
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Main_Category=sapply(
        strsplit(Category,";"),
        `[`,
        1
      ),
      Sub_Category=sapply(
        strsplit(Category,";"),
        `[`,
        2
      )
    )
  category_df$Main_Category[
    category_df$ID=="hsa04820"
  ] <- "Cellular Processes"
  kegg_compare_all <- kegg_compare_all %>%
    left_join(
      category_df[,c(
        "ID",
        "Main_Category"
      )],
      by="ID"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Main_Category=ifelse(
        is.na(Main_Category),
        "Unclassified",
        Main_Category
      )
    )
}
```

#### SEX adjusted

```{r external-04}
# ============================================================
# GSE135251 EXTERNAL VALIDATION WITH SEX ADJUSTMENT
#
# Internal:
# Steatosis    = 0 vs 1+2+3+4
# Inflammation = 0 vs 1+2+3+4
# Fibrosis     = 0 vs 1+2+3+4
#
# External:
# Fibrosis    = F0 vs F1-F4
# Steatosis   = supporting validation using NAS
# Inflammation= supporting validation using NAS
#
# Sex inferred from sex-specific RNA expression
# Models:
#   Fibrosis ~ Sex + Fibrosis
#   NAS       ~ Sex + NAS_score
#
# Gene FDR ≤ 0.05
# KEGG qvalue <= 0.10
# ============================================================
FDR_DEG <- 0.05
FDR_PATH <- 0.10
MIN_COUNT <- 3
# ============================================================
# 1. GEO PHENOTYPE
# ============================================================
gse <- getGEO(
  "GSE135251",
  GSEMatrix=TRUE
)[[1]]
pheno <- pData(gse)
pheno$Fibrosis_stage <- as.numeric(
  pheno$`fibrosis stage:ch1`
)
pheno$NAS_score <- as.numeric(
  pheno$`nas score:ch1`
)
cat("\nFIBROSIS STAGE\n")
print(table(pheno$Fibrosis_stage,useNA="ifany"))
cat("\nNAS SCORE\n")
print(table(pheno$NAS_score,useNA="ifany"))
# ============================================================
# 2. COUNTS
# ============================================================
count_file <- file.path(project_dir, "Analyisis/GSE135251_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz")
counts_df <- read.delim(
  gzfile(count_file),
  header=TRUE,
  check.names=FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
gene_ids <- sub(
  "\\..*$",
  "",
  counts_df[[1]]
)
counts <- as.matrix(
  counts_df[,-1,drop=FALSE]
)
storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"
rownames(counts) <- gene_ids
# ============================================================
# 3. MATCH COUNTS TO GEO
# ============================================================
common <- intersect(
  colnames(counts),
  rownames(pheno)
)
if(length(common)>0){
  counts <- counts[,common,drop=FALSE]
  pheno <- pheno[common,,drop=FALSE]
} else {
  count_key <- gsub(
    "\\s+",
    "",
    colnames(counts)
  )
  title_key <- gsub(
    "\\s+",
    "",
    pheno$title
  )
  idx <- match(
    count_key,
    title_key
  )
  keep <- !is.na(idx)
  counts <- counts[
    ,
    keep,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  pheno <- pheno[
    idx[keep],
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  colnames(counts) <- rownames(pheno)
}
stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(counts),
    rownames(pheno)
  )
)
cat(
  "\nMatched samples:",
  ncol(counts),
  "\n"
)
# ============================================================
# 4. INFER SEX FROM SEX-SPECIFIC GENES
# ============================================================
sex_genes <- c(
  "RPS4Y1",
  "DDX3Y",
  "KDM5D",
  "UTY",
  "XIST"
)
sex_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys=sex_genes,
  keytype="SYMBOL",
  columns=c("SYMBOL","ENTREZID")
)
sex_map <- sex_map[
  !is.na(sex_map$ENTREZID) &
    !duplicated(sex_map$SYMBOL),
  ,
  drop=FALSE
]
print(sex_map)
# Check whether counts use Entrez IDs
present_entrez <- intersect(
  as.character(sex_map$ENTREZID),
  rownames(counts)
)
cat(
  "\nSex-marker genes present in counts:",
  length(present_entrez),
  "\n"
)
print(present_entrez)
if(length(present_entrez)<3)
  stop("Too few sex-specific genes were found in the count matrix.")
# Preliminary DESeq2 object for normalization
dds_sex <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData=round(counts),
  colData=pheno,
  design=~1
)
dds_sex <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_sex)
norm_counts <- counts(
  dds_sex,
  normalized=TRUE
)
# Marker counts
marker_counts <- norm_counts[
  present_entrez,
  ,
  drop=FALSE
]
# Convert rownames back to gene symbols
marker_symbols <- sex_map$SYMBOL[
  match(
    present_entrez,
    as.character(sex_map$ENTREZID)
  )
]
rownames(marker_counts) <- marker_symbols
# log2 expression
marker_log <- log2(
  marker_counts + 1
)
# z-score each marker across samples
marker_z <- t(
  scale(
    t(marker_log)
  )
)
# Y-chromosome markers = male signal
male_genes <- intersect(
  c("RPS4Y1","DDX3Y","KDM5D","UTY"),
  rownames(marker_z)
)
# XIST = female-associated signal
female_genes <- intersect(
  "XIST",
  rownames(marker_z)
)
cat("\nMale markers used:\n")
print(male_genes)
cat("\nFemale marker used:\n")
print(female_genes)
if(length(male_genes)<2)
  stop("Too few Y-chromosome markers available.")
male_score <- colMeans(
  marker_z[
    male_genes,
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ],
  na.rm=TRUE
)
female_score <- if(length(female_genes)>0){
  colMeans(
    marker_z[
      female_genes,
      ,
      drop=FALSE
    ],
    na.rm=TRUE
  )
} else {
  rep(
    0,
    ncol(marker_z)
  )
}
sex_score <- male_score - female_score
pheno$Sex <- factor(
  ifelse(
    sex_score>0,
    "Male",
    "Female"
  ),
  levels=c(
    "Female",
    "Male"
  )
)
cat("\nINFERRED SEX\n")
print(table(pheno$Sex))
# ============================================================
# 5. FIBROSIS GROUP
# ============================================================
pheno$Fibrosis <- factor(
  ifelse(
    pheno$Fibrosis_stage==0,
    "F0",
    ifelse(
      pheno$Fibrosis_stage %in% 1:4,
      "F1_F4",
      NA
    )
  ),
  levels=c("F0","F1_F4")
)
cat("\nFIBROSIS GROUPS\n")
print(
  table(

    useNA="ifany"

)
# Check Sex x Fibrosis
cat("\nSEX BY FIBROSIS\n")
print(

  )
)
# ============================================================
# 6. FIBROSIS DESEQ2
# ============================================================
keep <- !is.na(pheno$Fibrosis) &
  !is.na(pheno$Sex)
pheno_fib <- pheno[
  keep,

  drop=FALSE
]
counts_fib <- counts[
  ,

]
keep_gene <- rowSums(

)>=10
counts_fib <- counts_fib[

dds_fib <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(

cat("\nFIBROSIS RESULTS NAMES\n")
print(resultsNames(dds_fib))
fib_coef <- grep(

)
if(length(fib_coef)!=1)
  stop("Fibrosis coefficient could not be uniquely identified.")
res_fib_ext <- results(

res_fib_ext <- res_fib_ext[
  !is.na(res_fib_ext$padj),

]
resLFC_fib_ext <- lfcShrink(

resLFC_fib_ext <- resLFC_fib_ext[
  !is.na(resLFC_fib_ext$padj),

]
# ============================================================
# 7. EXTERNAL FIBROSIS DEGs
# ============================================================
ext_fib_up <- rownames(

# ============================================================
# 8. ENTrez -> ENSEMBL
# ============================================================
convert_entrez_to_ensembl <- function(res){
  map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys=rownames(res),
    keytype="ENTREZID",
    columns=c("ENSEMBL","SYMBOL")
  )
  map <- map[
    !is.na(map$ENSEMBL) &
      !duplicated(map$ENTREZID),
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  x <- as.data.frame(res)
  x$ENTREZID <- rownames(x)
  x$ENSEMBL <- map$ENSEMBL[
    match(
      x$ENTREZID,
      map$ENTREZID
    )
  ]
  x <- x[
    !is.na(x$ENSEMBL),
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  x <- x[
    !duplicated(x$ENSEMBL),
    ,
    drop=FALSE
  ]
  rownames(x) <- x$ENSEMBL
  x
}

# 10. FIBROSIS EFFECT-SIZE CONCORDANCE
# ============================================================
fib_overlap <- intersect(
  rownames(
    subset(
      resLFC_fibrosis,

  "log2FoldChange"
]
fib_y <- res_fib_ext_ens[
  fib_overlap,
  "log2FoldChange"
]

  fib_x,
  fib_y
)

fib_y <- fib_y[ok]

fib_cor <- cor.test(
  fib_x,
  fib_y,
  method="spearman"
)
fib_binom <- binom.test(
  sum(same_fib),
  length(same_fib),
  p=0.5,
  alternative="greater"
)
cat(
  "\nFIBROSIS EFFECT CONCORDANCE\n",
  "Overlap:",length(fib_x),"\n",
  "Spearman rho:",
  round(
    unname(fib_cor$estimate),
    3
  ),"\n",
  "Spearman P:",
  format.pval(
    fib_cor$p.value,
    digits=4
  ),"\n",
  "Same direction:",
  round(
    100*mean(same_fib),
    2
  ),"%\n",
  "Binomial P:",
  format.pval(
    fib_binom$p.value,
    digits=4
  ),"\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 15. KEGG
# ============================================================
run_kegg <- function(res,direction){
  genes <- if(direction=="up"){
    rownames(
      subset(
        res,
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj<=FDR_DEG &
          log2FoldChange>0
      )
    )
  } else {
    rownames(
      subset(
        res,
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj<=FDR_DEG &
          log2FoldChange<0
      )
    )
  }
  genes <- sub(
    "\\..*$",
    "",
    genes
  )
  genes <- unique(
    genes[
      grepl("^ENSG",genes)
    ]
  )
  if(length(genes)<5)
    return(NULL)
  map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys=genes,
    keytype="ENSEMBL",
    columns="ENTREZID"
  )
  entrez <- unique(
    map$ENTREZID[
      !is.na(map$ENTREZID)
    ]
  )
  if(length(entrez)<5)
    return(NULL)
  ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene=entrez,
    organism="hsa",
    pvalueCutoff=FDR_PATH
  )
  if(is.null(ek))
    return(NULL)
  ek@result <- subset(
    ek@result,
    qvalue<=FDR_PATH
  )
  ek
}

# 18. PATHWAY REPLICATION
# ============================================================
get_pathway_overlap <- function(
  discovery,
  external
){
  if(
    is.null(discovery) ||
    is.null(external)
  )
    return(character(0))
  intersect(
    discovery@result$ID,
    external@result$ID
  )
}

  ext_kegg_fib_down

  ext_kegg_nas_up

  ext_kegg_nas_down
)

  ext_kegg_nas_up
)
inf_down_pathways <- get_pathway_overlap(

  ext_kegg_nas_down
)

# 20. PANEL A — FIBROSIS LFC CONCORDANCE
# ============================================================
common_fib <- intersect(
  rownames(resLFC_fibrosis),
  rownames(res_fib_ext_ens)
)
df_fib <- data.frame(
  Gene=common_fib,
  Discovery_LFC=
    resLFC_fibrosis[
      common_fib,
      "log2FoldChange"
    ],
  Validation_LFC=
    res_fib_ext_ens[
      common_fib,
      "log2FoldChange"
    ],
  Discovery_padj=
    resLFC_fibrosis[
      common_fib,
      "padj"
    ],
  Validation_padj=
    res_fib_ext_ens[
      common_fib,
      "padj"
    ]
) %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(.)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Status=case_when(
      Discovery_padj<=FDR_DESEQ &
        Validation_padj<=FDR_DESEQ &
        sign(Discovery_LFC)==sign(Validation_LFC) ~
        "Replicated (concordant)",
      Discovery_padj<=FDR_DESEQ &
        Validation_padj<=FDR_DESEQ &
        sign(Discovery_LFC)!=sign(Validation_LFC) ~
        "Discordant direction",
      Discovery_padj<=FDR_DESEQ ~
        "Discovery-only",

get_stats <- function(
  res_disc,
  res_val,
  fdr=FDR_DESEQ
){
  disc <- subset(
    res_disc,
    !is.na(padj) &
      padj<=fdr
  )
  val <- subset(
    res_val,
    !is.na(padj) &
      padj<=fdr
  )
  overlap <- intersect(
    rownames(disc),
    rownames(val)
  )
  if(length(overlap)<2){
    return(
      data.frame(
        rho=NA,
        p=NA,
        pct_concordant=NA,
        n=length(overlap),
        binom_p=NA
      )
    )
  }
  x <- res_disc[
    overlap,
    "log2FoldChange"
  ]
  y <- res_val[
    overlap,
    "log2FoldChange"
  ]
  ok <- complete.cases(x,y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  rho <- cor.test(
    x,
    y,
    method="spearman"
  )
  same <- sign(x)==sign(y)
  binom <- binom.test(
    sum(same),
    length(same),
    p=0.5,
    alternative="greater"
  )
  data.frame(
    rho=unname(rho$estimate),
    p=rho$p.value,
    pct_concordant=
      mean(same)*100,
    n=length(same),
    binom_p=binom$p.value
  )
}

  res_fib_ext_ens

build_kegg_compare_df <- function(
  disc_kegg,
  ext_kegg,
  direction_label
){
  if(
    is.null(disc_kegg) ||
    is.null(ext_kegg)
  )
    return(NULL)
  if(
    nrow(disc_kegg@result)==0 ||
    nrow(ext_kegg@result)==0
  )
    return(NULL)
  shared <- intersect(
    disc_kegg@result$ID,
    ext_kegg@result$ID
  )
  if(length(shared)==0)
    return(NULL)
  d <- disc_kegg@result %>%
    filter(
      ID %in% shared
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      Description,
      Cohort="Discovery",
      p.adjust,
      Count
    )
  v <- ext_kegg@result %>%
    filter(
      ID %in% shared
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      Description,
      Cohort="GSE135251",
      p.adjust,
      Count
    )
  bind_rows(
    d,
    v
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction=direction_label
    )
}

get_kegg_category <- function(
  pathway_id
){
  info <- tryCatch(

  else

}

    left_join(

        ,
        c(
          "ID",
          "Main_Category"
        )
      ],
      by="ID"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Main_Category=ifelse(
        is.na(Main_Category),
        "Unclassified",
        Main_Category
      )
    )
}
```

```{r external-05}
## =====================================================================
## FIGURE 3 + TABLES S5-S7: external transcriptomic validation (full run)
##
## Needs in the session:
##   dds   DESeqDataSet, raw counts, 208 samples,
##         colData = phenotype_subset
##   val_GSE162694, val_GSE135251_unadj, val_GSE135251_sexadj
##         (lists made at the end of each external-cohort chunk)
## =====================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2); library(apeglm); library(org.Hs.eg.db); library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(clusterProfiler)
})
stopifnot("run the external-cohort chunks first" =
            all(sapply(c("val_GSE162694", "val_GSE135251_unadj", "val_GSE135251_sexadj"), exists)))
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## A. Discovery DESeq2 = Table S1 / Fig. 1
##    genes >= 10 counts in >= 10 samples (21,114); ~ Age + BMI + Sex + trait;
##    results(alpha = 0.05); apeglm
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
raw <- counts(dds)
cd  <- as.data.frame(colData(dds))
num  <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
pick <- function(pat) { v <- grep(pat, names(cd), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (!length(v)) stop("no column matching ", pat); v[1] }
sx <- tolower(trimws(as.character(cd[[pick("gender|^sex")]])))
cd$Sex <- factor(ifelse(sx %in% c("female", "f", "1", "woman"), "Female",
                 ifelse(sx %in% c("male", "m", "0", "man"), "Male", NA)), c("Female", "Male"))
cd$Age_z <- as.numeric(scale(num(cd[[pick("^age")]])))
cd$BMI_z <- as.numeric(scale(num(cd[[pick("^bmi")]])))
for (tr in c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"))
  cd[[tr]] <- factor(ifelse(num(cd[[pick(paste0("^", tr, "($|_kleiner)"))]]) >= 1, "Yes", "No"), c("No", "Yes"))
stopifnot("sex must be 153 F / 55 M" = identical(as.vector(table(cd$Sex)), c(153L, 55L)))
KEEP <- rowSums(raw >= 10) >= 10
stopifnot(sum(KEEP) == 21114)
ALPHA <- FDR_GENE
run_deg <- function(tr) {
  ok <- complete.cases(cd[, c("Age_z", "BMI_z", "Sex", tr)])
  d  <- DESeq(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(raw[KEEP, ok], cd[ok, ],
              as.formula(paste("~ Age_z + BMI_z + Sex +", tr))), quiet = TRUE)
  cf  <- paste0(tr, "_Yes_vs_No")
  res <- results(d, name = cf, alpha = ALPHA)
  r <- as.data.frame(lfcShrink(d, coef = cf, res = res, type = "apeglm", quiet = TRUE))
  rownames(r) <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(r))
  r$Gene <- unname(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, rownames(r), "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"))
  r
}
fig2_res <- setNames(lapply(c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"), run_deg),
                     c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"))
print(sapply(fig2_res, function(r) c(tested = sum(!is.na(r$padj)), DEGs = sum(r$padj <= FDR_GENE, na.rm = TRUE))))

to_entrez <- function(ens) unique(na.omit(unname(
  mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, ens, "ENTREZID", "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"))))
fibr <- fig2_res$Fibrosis

kegg_fun <- function(ens) {
  g <- to_entrez(ens); if (length(g) < 3) return(NULL)
  k <- enrichKEGG(g, organism = "hsa", universe = universe,
                  pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "BH")
  if (!is.null(k)) k@result <- k@result[k@result$p.adjust <= FDR_KEGG & k@result$Count >= 3, ]
  k
}

  distinct(ens, .keep_all = TRUE)

  s <- symtab$sym[match(ens, symtab$ens)]

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Gene-level replication
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
compare_one <- function(d, e, trait, cohort) {
  e <- as.data.frame(e)
  common <- intersect(rownames(d)[!is.na(d$padj)], rownames(e)[!is.na(e$padj)])
  ds <- rownames(d)[!is.na(d$padj) & d$padj <= FDR_G]
  es <- rownames(e)[!is.na(e$padj) & e$padj <= FDR_G]
  sh <- intersect(ds, es)
  x <- d[sh, "log2FoldChange"]; y <- e[sh, "log2FoldChange"]
  same <- sign(x) == sign(y)
  gw <- sign(d[common, "log2FoldChange"]) == sign(e[common, "log2FoldChange"])
  summ <- data.frame(
    Cohort = cohort, Trait = trait,
    External_phenotype = if (trait == "Fibrosis") "Fibrosis F0 vs F1-F4" else "NAS (continuous)",
    Discovery_DEGs = length(ds),
    Discovery_DEGs_measured_externally = length(intersect(ds, common)),
    External_DEGs = length(es),
    Shared_DEGs = length(sh),
    Replication_pct = round(100 * length(sh) / length(ds), 1),
    Same_direction = sum(same),
    Same_direction_pct = round(100 * mean(same), 1),
    Binomial_p = signif(binom.test(sum(same), length(sh), 0.5)$p.value, 3),
    Spearman_rho_shared = round(cor(x, y, method = "spearman"), 3),
    Genes_in_common = length(common),
    Spearman_rho_genomewide = round(cor(d[common, "log2FoldChange"], e[common, "log2FoldChange"],
                                        method = "spearman"), 3),
    Same_direction_genomewide_pct = round(100 * mean(gw), 1),
    Discordant_genes = paste(sym_of(sh[!same]), collapse = "; "),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  genes <- data.frame(Cohort = cohort, Trait = trait, Ensembl = sh, Symbol = sym_of(sh),
                      Discovery_log2FC = x, Discovery_FDR = d[sh, "padj"],
                      External_log2FC = y, External_FDR = e[sh, "padj"],
                      Concordant = same, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(Trait, Discovery_FDR)
  scatter <- data.frame(Cohort = cohort, Trait = trait, ens = common,
                        disc = d[common, "log2FoldChange"], ext = e[common, "log2FoldChange"],
                        dsig = common %in% ds, esig = common %in% es) %>%
    mutate(Status = case_when(dsig & esig & sign(disc) == sign(ext) ~ "Replicated (concordant)",
                              dsig & esig ~ "Discordant direction",
                              dsig ~ "Discovery-only",
                              esig ~ "Validation-only",
                              TRUE ~ "Not significant"))
  list(summ = summ, genes = genes, scatter = scatter, ds = ds, es = es)
}
run_set <- function(cset) {
  out <- list()
  for (cn in names(cset)) for (t in TR)
    out[[paste(cn, t)]] <- compare_one(disc[[t]], cset[[cn]][[field[[t]]]], t, cn)
  out
}
cmp_main <- run_set(main)
cmp_sens <- run_set(sens)
S12A <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_main, `[[`, "summ"))
S12B <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_main, `[[`, "genes"))
S13A <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_sens, `[[`, "summ"))
S13B <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_sens, `[[`, "genes"))
print(S12A[, c("Cohort", "Trait", "Discovery_DEGs", "Shared_DEGs", "Replication_pct",
               "Same_direction_pct", "Spearman_rho_shared", "Spearman_rho_genomewide",
               "Same_direction_genomewide_pct")], row.names = FALSE)
print(S13A[, c("Cohort", "Trait", "Shared_DEGs", "Same_direction_pct", "Spearman_rho_shared",
               "Discordant_genes")], row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. KEGG replication (fibrosis): significant in discovery AND external
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
fib <- disc$Fibrosis
up_f   <- rownames(fib)[!is.na(fib$padj) & fib$padj <= FDR_G & fib$log2FoldChange > 0]
down_f <- rownames(fib)[!is.na(fib$padj) & fib$padj <= FDR_G & fib$log2FoldChange < 0]
stopifnot(exists("ekegg_up_fibrosis"), exists("ekegg_down_fibrosis"))
sig_tab <- function(k) {
  if (is.null(k) || !nrow(k@result)) return(data.frame(ID = character(), p.adjust = numeric(), Count = integer()))
  k@result %>% filter(p.adjust <= FDR_K, Count >= MIN_COUNT) %>% dplyr::select(ID, p.adjust, Count)
}
all_cohorts <- c(main, sens)
S14 <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Up", "Down"), function(dir) {
  dk <- if (dir == "Up") ekegg_up_fibrosis else ekegg_down_fibrosis
  if (is.null(dk) || !nrow(dk@result)) return(NULL)
  base <- dk@result %>% filter(p.adjust <= FDR_K, Count >= MIN_COUNT) %>%
    transmute(Direction = dir, ID, Description,
              Category = if ("category" %in% names(dk@result)) category else NA_character_,
              Discovery_FDR = p.adjust, Discovery_genes = Count)
  for (cn in names(all_cohorts)) {
    ek <- if (dir == "Up") all_cohorts[[cn]]$kegg_fib_up else all_cohorts[[cn]]$kegg_fib_down
    er <- if (is.null(ek) || !nrow(ek@result)) data.frame(ID = character(), p.adjust = numeric(), Count = integer())
          else ek@result %>% dplyr::select(ID, p.adjust, Count)
    base <- left_join(base, er, by = "ID")
    names(base)[names(base) == "p.adjust"] <- paste0(cn, "_FDR")
    names(base)[names(base) == "Count"]    <- paste0(cn, "_genes")
    base[[paste0(cn, "_significant")]] <- base$ID %in% sig_tab(ek)$ID
  }
  base
}))
S14$Replicated_in <- apply(S14[, paste0(names(main), "_significant")], 1,
                           function(v) paste(names(main)[v], collapse = " + "))
S14$Replicated_in[S14$Replicated_in == ""] <- "none"
S14 <- S14 %>% arrange(Direction, desc(nchar(Replicated_in)), Discovery_FDR)
## KEGG category for rows lacking one
need <- is.na(S14$Category) | S14$Category == ""
if (any(need) && requireNamespace("KEGGREST", quietly = TRUE)) {
  S14$Category[need] <- sapply(S14$ID[need], function(id) {
    cl <- tryCatch(KEGGREST::keggGet(id)[[1]]$CLASS, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (length(cl)) trimws(strsplit(cl[1], ";")[[1]][1]) else NA_character_
  })
}
S14$Category[S14$ID == "hsa04820"] <- "Cellular Processes"
S14$Category[is.na(S14$Category)] <- "Other"
print(S14 %>% dplyr::select(Direction, Description, Discovery_FDR, Replicated_in), row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Figure 6
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## ---- Nature Metabolism text sizes ------------------------------------
## Canvas is 17 x 21 in; the journal prints a double-column figure at 183 mm
## (7.2 in), so everything is shrunk by 7.2/17. K converts the size we want
## AT PRINT (5-7 pt; panel letters 8 pt bold) into the size to use here.
FIG_W <- 17; FIG_H <- 21
K   <- FIG_W / (183 / 25.4)            # ~2.36
pt  <- function(x) x * K               # theme text (pt)
mm  <- function(x) x * K / .pt         # geom_text / geom_label size (mm)
FONT <- "Helvetica"                    # "Arial" on Windows
theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = pt(6), base_family = FONT) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = pt(7), hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = pt(6), hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = pt(6.5)),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = pt(6)),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = pt(6.5)),
        legend.text = element_text(size = pt(6)),
        legend.key.size = unit(pt(3), "mm"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = pt(6.5)))
## ---- a: log2FC concordance, 3 traits x 2 cohorts ---------------------
sc <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_main, `[[`, "scatter")) %>%
  mutate(Trait = factor(Trait, levels = TR), Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = names(main)),
         Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Not significant", "Validation-only", "Discovery-only",
                                            "Discordant direction", "Replicated (concordant)"))) %>%
  arrange(Status)
lab_a <- S12A %>%
  mutate(Trait = factor(Trait, levels = TR), Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = names(main)),
         label = sprintf("Genome-wide: ρ = %.2f, %.1f%% same direction (n = %s)\nShared DEGs: ρ = %.2f, %.1f%% same direction (n = %d)",
                         Spearman_rho_genomewide, Same_direction_genomewide_pct,
                         format(Genes_in_common, big.mark = ","),
                         Spearman_rho_shared, Same_direction_pct, Shared_DEGs))
status_col <- c("Not significant" = "grey85", "Validation-only" = "#F4A582",
                "Discovery-only" = "#4393C3", "Discordant direction" = "grey40",
                "Replicated (concordant)" = "#B2182B")
panel_a <- ggplot(sc, aes(disc, ext)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Status), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(data = subset(sc, Status %in% c("Replicated (concordant)", "Discordant direction")),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#B2182B", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_label(data = lab_a, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = -0.02, vjust = 1.1,
             size = mm(5.5), label.size = 0.3, family = FONT, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(Trait ~ Cohort, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_col, name = "Gene status") +
  labs(x = expression(bold(log[2]*FC~"—"~discovery)),
       y = expression(bold(log[2]*FC~"—"~external)),
       title = "Signature replication in external cohorts") +
  theme_pub + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1)))
## ---- b: Venn diagrams ------------------------------------------------
venn_one <- function(t, ttl) {
  lst <- list(cmp_main[[paste("GSE162694", t)]]$ds,
              cmp_main[[paste("GSE162694", t)]]$es,
              cmp_main[[paste("GSE135251", t)]]$es)
  names(lst) <- c(paste("Discovery", tolower(t)), "GSE162694", "GSE135251")
  ggvenn(lst, fill_color = c("#6BAED6", "#DE2D26", "#31A354"), fill_alpha = 0.45,
         stroke_size = 0.5, set_name_size = mm(6.5), text_size = mm(6.5), show_percentage = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(ttl) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = pt(7), family = FONT))
}
panel_b <- plot_grid(venn_one("Fibrosis", "Fibrosis"),
                     venn_one("Steatosis", "Steatosis (discovery) vs NAS (external)"),
                     venn_one("Inflammation", "Inflammation (discovery) vs NAS (external)"),
                     nrow = 1)
## ---- c: concordance among shared DEGs --------------------------------
## Replaces the whole "c" block in the Figure 3 script (from "## ---- c:" up to
## the line before "## ---- d:"). Changes:
##   1. Cohort colours are named, so red is always GSE162694 and green is always
##      GSE135251 (the same red/green as the cohort circles in the Venn diagrams, b).
##   2. The colour key is now actually drawn. cowplot::get_legend() returns an
##      empty box with ggplot2 >= 3.5 when the legend sits at the bottom, which
##      is why the key was missing; pick_legend() takes the non-empty one.
COHORT_COL <- c(GSE162694 = "#DE2D26", GSE135251 = "#31A354")
cdat <- S12A %>% mutate(Trait = factor(Trait, levels = rev(TR)),
                        Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = names(main)))
panel_c1 <- ggplot(cdat, aes(Same_direction_pct, Trait, fill = Cohort)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%\nn = %d", Same_direction_pct, Shared_DEGs)),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), hjust = -0.1, size = mm(6), lineheight = 0.85, family = FONT) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COHORT_COL, breaks = names(COHORT_COL), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 145), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(x = "% same direction", y = NULL, title = "Directional concordance") +
  theme_pub + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal",
                    legend.text = element_text(size = pt(6.5)))
panel_c2 <- ggplot(cdat, aes(Spearman_rho_shared, Trait, fill = Cohort)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Spearman_rho_shared)),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), hjust = -0.15, size = mm(6), family = FONT) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COHORT_COL, breaks = names(COHORT_COL), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = expression(bold("Spearman "*rho*" of "*log[2]*FC)), y = NULL, title = "Effect-size correlation") +
  theme_pub + theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.y = element_blank())
pick_legend <- function(p) {                      # works with ggplot2 < 3.5 and >= 3.5
  g <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(p)
  boxes <- g$grobs[grepl("^guide-box", g$layout$name)]
  boxes[!vapply(boxes, inherits, logical(1), "zeroGrob")][[1]]
}
leg_c   <- pick_legend(panel_c1)
panel_c <- plot_grid(plot_grid(panel_c1 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                               panel_c2 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                               nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.2, 1)),
                     leg_c, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.08))
## ---- d: replicated fibrosis KEGG pathways ----------------------------
rep_ids <- S14$ID[S14$Replicated_in != "none"]
ddat <- bind_rows(
  S14 %>% filter(ID %in% rep_ids) %>%
    transmute(ID, Description, Category, Direction, Cohort = "Discovery", FDR = Discovery_FDR),
  bind_rows(lapply(names(main), function(cn) S14 %>%
    filter(ID %in% rep_ids, .data[[paste0(cn, "_significant")]]) %>%
    transmute(ID, Description, Category, Direction, Cohort = cn, FDR = .data[[paste0(cn, "_FDR")]])))
) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Discovery", names(main))),
         Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description[order(Category, Direction)]))))
stopifnot("a plotted KEGG point is not significant" = all(ddat$FDR <= FDR_K))
panel_d <- if (nrow(ddat)) {
  ggplot(ddat, aes(Cohort, Description, size = -log10(FDR), colour = Direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5), order = 1)) +
    facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
               labeller = labeller(Category = label_wrap_gen(12))) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 32)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(Discovery = "Discovery", GSE162694 = "GSE\n162694", GSE135251 = "GSE\n135251")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = COL_UP, Down = COL_DOWN)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 11), name = expression(-log[10]*"(FDR)")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Replicated KEGG pathways (fibrosis)",
         subtitle = sprintf("FDR ≤ %.2f, ≥ 3 genes; discovery and ≥ 1\nexternal cohort", FDR_K, MIN_COUNT)) +
    theme_pub + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = pt(5.5), hjust = 0),
                      axis.text.y = element_text(size = pt(6), lineheight = 0.85),
                      axis.text.x = element_text(size = pt(6), lineheight = 0.85),
                      legend.box = "vertical", legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"),
                      legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank())
} else ggplot() + annotate("text", 0.5, 0.5, label = "No replicated KEGG pathways", size = mm(7)) + theme_void()
fig3 <- plot_grid(
  panel_a,
  panel_b,
  plot_grid(panel_c, panel_d, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1.15), labels = c("c", "d"), label_size = pt(8), label_fontfamily = FONT),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1.65, 0.9, 1.1), labels = c("a", "b", ""), label_size = pt(8), label_fontfamily = FONT) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
ggsave(fv("Fig3_validation.png"),  fig3, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H, dpi = 400, bg = "white")
ggsave(fv("Fig3_validation.pdf"),  fig3, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H, bg = "white",

rng <- function(v, d = 1) if (length(unique(round(v, d))) == 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), v[1]) else
  sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f–%.", d, "f"), min(v), max(v))
by_t <- function(df, t) df[df$Trait == t, ]
L <- c("================ EXTERNAL VALIDATION - FOR THE MANUSCRIPT ================",
       sprintf("Discovery DEGs (FDR <= 0.05): fibrosis %d, steatosis %d, inflammation %d",
               n_disc["Fibrosis"], n_disc["Steatosis"], n_disc["Inflammation"]))
for (t in TR) {
  a <- by_t(S12A, t); s <- by_t(S13A, t)
  L <- c(L, "", toupper(t),
    sprintf("  shared DEGs: %s (GSE162694 / GSE135251)", paste(a$Shared_DEGs, collapse = " / ")),
    sprintf("  replication rate: %s%%", paste(a$Replication_pct, collapse = " / ")),
    sprintf("  same direction: %s%% | rho shared: %s", paste(a$Same_direction_pct, collapse = " / "),
            paste(a$Spearman_rho_shared, collapse = " / ")),
    sprintf("  genome-wide rho: %s | same direction: %s%%", paste(a$Spearman_rho_genomewide, collapse = " / "),
            paste(a$Same_direction_genomewide_pct, collapse = " / ")),
    sprintf("  discordant: %s", paste(ifelse(a$Discordant_genes == "", "none", a$Discordant_genes), collapse = " | ")),
    sprintf("  sex-adjusted GSE135251: shared %d, same direction %.1f%%, rho %.3f, discordant: %s",
            s$Shared_DEGs, s$Same_direction_pct, s$Spearman_rho_shared,
            ifelse(s$Discordant_genes == "", "none", s$Discordant_genes)))
}
nf <- S12A$Trait != "Fibrosis"
L <- c(L, "", "RANGES",
  sprintf("  same direction, fibrosis: %s%%; steatosis+inflammation: %s%%",
          rng(S12A$Same_direction_pct[!nf]), rng(S12A$Same_direction_pct[nf])),
  sprintf("  rho shared, all: %s", rng(S12A$Spearman_rho_shared, 3)),
  sprintf("  replication: fibrosis %s%%, steatosis %s%%, inflammation %s%%",
          rng(by_t(S12A, "Fibrosis")$Replication_pct), rng(by_t(S12A, "Steatosis")$Replication_pct),
          rng(by_t(S12A, "Inflammation")$Replication_pct)),
  sprintf("  genome-wide rho: %s; same direction: %s%%", rng(S12A$Spearman_rho_genomewide, 2),
          rng(S12A$Same_direction_genomewide_pct, 0)),
  sprintf("  sex-adjusted: same direction %s%%, rho %s", rng(S13A$Same_direction_pct),
          rng(S13A$Spearman_rho_shared, 3)),
  "", "KEGG (fibrosis)",
  sprintf("  significant in discovery: %d (up %d, down %d)", nrow(S14),
          sum(S14$Direction == "Up"), sum(S14$Direction == "Down")))
for (r in c("GSE162694 + GSE135251", "GSE162694", "GSE135251", "none")) {
  q <- S14[S14$Replicated_in == r, ]
  if (nrow(q)) L <- c(L, sprintf("  %-22s %s", paste0(r, ":"),
                                 paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", q$Description, tolower(q$Direction)), collapse = "; ")))
}
L <- c(L, "",
       "==========================================================================")
writeLines(L, fv("validation_numbers.txt"))
cat(paste(L, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
cat("\nWrote:", fv("validation_numbers.txt"), "and", fv("Fig3_validation.png"), "\n")
```
