#### ST000915

```{r external-09}
# ============================================================
# ST000915 EXTERNAL LIVER LIPIDOMICS VALIDATION
# STEATOSIS ONLY
#
# Internal:
#   Table_S4.xlsx
#   Steatosis, FDR ≤ 0.10
#
# External:
#   ST000915
#   Normal vs Steatosis/NASH/Cirrhosis
#   Adjusted for Age + BMI + Sex
#
# No tables are saved.
# Only final concordance table is printed.
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ============================================================
library(readxl)
# ============================================================
# 2. INTERNAL TABLE S4
# ============================================================
table_s4 <- my_results
required_s4 <- c(
  "Lipid main ID",
  "Phenotype",
  "logFC",
  "adj.P.Val"
)
if (!all(required_s4 %in% colnames(table_s4))) {
  stop(
    "Table S3 is missing required columns: ",
    paste(
      setdiff(required_s4, colnames(table_s4)),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 3. INTERNAL STEATOSIS SIGNIFICANT LIPIDS
# ============================================================
int_steatosis <- table_s4 %>%
  filter(
    Phenotype == "Steatosis",
    !is.na(`Lipid main ID`),
    !is.na(logFC),
    !is.na(adj.P.Val),
    adj.P.Val <= 0.10
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Lipid = as.character(`Lipid main ID`),
    Internal_logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
    Internal_FDR = as.numeric(adj.P.Val),
    Internal_Direction = ifelse(
      Internal_logFC > 0,
      "Up",
      "Down"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Lipid,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )
if (nrow(int_steatosis) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No significant Steatosis lipids found in Table S4."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 4. ST000915 ANALYSIS IDs
# ============================================================
analysis_ids <- c(
  "AN001485",
  "AN001486",
  "AN001487",
  "AN001488",
  "AN001489",
  "AN001490"
)
# ============================================================
# 5. DOWNLOAD ST000915 FILE
# ============================================================
download_mwtab <- function(analysis_id) {

  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.metabolomicsworkbench.org/data/",
    "study_textformat_view.php?",
    "STUDY_ID=ST000915&",
    "ANALYSIS_ID=",
    analysis_id,
    "&MODE=d"
  )

  x <- readLines(
    url,
    warn = FALSE
  )

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No data returned for ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  x
}
# ============================================================
# 6. EXTRACT MS_METABOLITE_DATA
# ============================================================
get_ms_section <- function(
    analysis_id
) {

  x <- download_mwtab(
    analysis_id
  )

  start <- grep(
    "^MS_METABOLITE_DATA_START",
    x
  )

  end <- grep(
    "^MS_METABOLITE_DATA_END",
    x
  )

  if (length(start) == 0 ||
      length(end) == 0) {

    stop(
      "MS_METABOLITE_DATA section not found in ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  x[
    (start[1] + 1):(end[1] - 1)
  ]
}
# ============================================================
# 7. PARSE ST000915 LIPID DATA
# ============================================================
parse_lipid_analysis <- function(
    analysis_id
) {

  section <- get_ms_section(
    analysis_id
  )

  # Remove completely empty lines
  section <- section[
    nzchar(trimws(section))
  ]

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Find rows containing actual NASH sample IDs
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  nash_pattern <- "NASH[0-9]+"

  # Identify lines that contain NASH sample IDs
  sample_lines <- section[
    grepl(
      nash_pattern,
      section,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (length(sample_lines) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No NASH sample IDs found in ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Locate the Samples row / line by searching for a line
  # where NASH sample IDs occur consecutively
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  sample_line_index <- which(
    sapply(
      section,
      function(z) {
        ids <- str_extract_all(
          z,
          "(?i)NASH[0-9]+"
        )[[1]]

        length(ids) >= 2
      }
    )
  )

  if (length(sample_line_index) == 0) {

    # Alternative: use first line containing NASH IDs
    sample_line_index <- which(
      grepl(
        "(?i)NASH[0-9]+",
        section
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(sample_line_index) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not locate sample information in ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  sample_line_index <- sample_line_index[1]

  sample_line <- section[
    sample_line_index
  ]

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract sample IDs
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  sample_ids <- str_extract_all(
    sample_line,
    "(?i)NASH[0-9]+"
  )[[1]]

  sample_ids <- toupper(
    sample_ids
  )

  sample_ids <- unique(
    sample_ids
  )

  if (length(sample_ids) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No sample IDs extracted from ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Split sample line
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  sample_fields <- strsplit(
    sample_line,
    "\t",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  sample_fields <- trimws(
    sample_fields
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Find columns containing sample IDs
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  sample_cols <- which(
    grepl(
      "(?i)^NASH[0-9]+$",
      sample_fields
    )
  )

  # If IDs have prefixes/suffixes, locate them using
  # exact position from the sample line
  if (length(sample_cols) == 0) {

    sample_cols <- which(
      grepl(
        "(?i)NASH[0-9]+",
        sample_fields
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(sample_cols) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify sample columns in ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  sample_ids <- toupper(
    str_extract(
      sample_fields[
        sample_cols
      ],
      "(?i)NASH[0-9]+"
    )
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Determine feature rows
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  data_lines <- section[
    (sample_line_index + 1):length(section)
  ]

  feature_list <- list()

  for (line in data_lines) {

    fields <- strsplit(
      line,
      "\t",
      fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]]

    if (length(fields) <
        max(sample_cols)) {
      next
    }

    feature <- trimws(
      fields[1]
    )

    if (
      is.na(feature) ||
      feature == ""
    ) {
      next
    }

    # Skip section/header lines
    if (
      grepl(
        "^(DataType|Metabolite|Compound|Samples?)$",
        feature,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    ) {
      next
    }

    vals <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        fields[
          sample_cols
        ]
      )
    )

    feature_list[[feature]] <- vals
  }

  if (length(feature_list) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No lipid features extracted from ",
      analysis_id
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert to matrix
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  feature_names <- names(
    feature_list
  )

  mat <- do.call(
    rbind,
    feature_list
  )

  rownames(mat) <- feature_names
  colnames(mat) <- sample_ids

  mat
}
# ============================================================
# 8. DOWNLOAD + PARSE ALL SIX ANALYSES
# ============================================================
matrix_list <- lapply(
  analysis_ids,
  parse_lipid_analysis
)
names(matrix_list) <- analysis_ids
# ============================================================
# 9. COMMON SAMPLES
# ============================================================
common_samples <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  lapply(
    matrix_list,
    colnames
  )
)
if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No common samples across ST000915 lipid classes."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 10. ALIGN ALL MATRICES
# ============================================================
matrix_list <- lapply(
  matrix_list,
  function(x) {

    x[
      ,
      common_samples,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }
)
# ============================================================
# 11. COMBINE ALL LIPID CLASSES
# ============================================================
ext_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  matrix_list
)
# ============================================================
# 12. REMOVE DUPLICATE FEATURES
# ============================================================
ext_mat <- ext_mat[
  !duplicated(
    rownames(ext_mat)
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
# ============================================================
# 13. CHECK EXTERNAL MATRIX
# ============================================================
if (
  nrow(ext_mat) == 0 ||
  ncol(ext_mat) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "External lipid matrix is empty."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 14. DOWNLOAD METADATA
# ============================================================
meta_url <- paste0(
  "https://www.metabolomicsworkbench.org/data/",
  "study_textformat_view.php?",
  "STUDY_ID=ST000915&",
  "ANALYSIS_ID=AN001488&",
  "MODE=d"
)
meta_lines <- readLines(
  meta_url,
  warn = FALSE
)
# ============================================================
# 15. EXTRACT SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS
# ============================================================
ssf_lines <- meta_lines[
  grep(
    "^SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS",
    meta_lines
  )
]
ssf_lines <- ssf_lines[
  !grepl(
    "^#SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS",
    ssf_lines
  )
]
if (length(ssf_lines) == 0) {
  stop(
    "SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS not found."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 16. PARSE CLINICAL METADATA
# ============================================================
parse_ssf <- function(x) {

  fields <- strsplit(
    x,
    "\t",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  if (length(fields) < 4) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  sample <- trimws(
    fields[3]
  )

  if (!grepl(
    "^NASH[0-9]+$",
    sample,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metadata <- paste(
    fields[4:length(fields)],
    collapse = "; "
  )

  diagnosis <- str_match(
    metadata,
    "(?i)Diagnosis:([^;]+)"
  )[, 2]

  sex <- str_match(
    metadata,
    "(?i)GENDER=([^;]+)"
  )[, 2]

  bmi <- str_match(
    metadata,
    "(?i)BMI=([^;]+)"
  )[, 2]

  age <- str_match(
    metadata,
    "(?i)AGE=([^;]+)"
  )[, 2]

  data.frame(
    Sample = sample,
    Diagnosis = trimws(
      diagnosis
    ),
    Sex = trimws(
      sex
    ),
    BMI = trimws(
      bmi
    ),
    Age = trimws(
      age
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
meta_list <- lapply(
  ssf_lines,
  parse_ssf
)
ext_meta <- bind_rows(
  meta_list
)
if (nrow(ext_meta) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No ST000915 metadata were parsed."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 17. CLEAN VARIABLES
# ============================================================
ext_meta$Age <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(
    ext_meta$Age
  )
)
ext_meta$BMI <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(
    ext_meta$BMI
  )
)
ext_meta$Sex <- toupper(
  trimws(
    ext_meta$Sex
  )
)
# ============================================================
# 18. DEFINE STEATOSIS
# ============================================================
# Keep ONLY Normal vs Steatosis
ext_meta <- ext_meta[
  ext_meta$Diagnosis %in% c("Normal", "Steatosis"),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
ext_meta$Steatosis <- ifelse(
  ext_meta$Diagnosis == "Normal", 0, 1
)
# Check sample numbers
table(ext_meta$Diagnosis)
table(ext_meta$Steatosis)
# ============================================================
# 19. KEEP SAMPLES IN BOTH MATRIX + METADATA
# ============================================================
ext_meta <- ext_meta[
  ext_meta$Sample %in%
    colnames(ext_mat),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
ext_meta <- ext_meta[
  !duplicated(
    ext_meta$Sample
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
# ============================================================
# 20. COMPLETE CASES
# ============================================================
keep <- complete.cases(
  ext_meta[
    ,
    c(
      "Age",
      "BMI",
      "Sex",
      "Steatosis"
    )
  ]
)
ext_meta <- ext_meta[
  keep,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(ext_meta) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No complete-case samples remain."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 21. ALIGN MATRIX + METADATA
# ============================================================
ext_mat_limma <- ext_mat[
  ,
  ext_meta$Sample,
  drop = FALSE
]
ext_meta <- ext_meta[
  match(
    colnames(ext_mat_limma),
    ext_meta$Sample
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
rownames(ext_meta) <- ext_meta$Sample
stopifnot(
  nrow(ext_meta) > 0
)
stopifnot(
  ncol(ext_mat_limma) > 0
)
stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(ext_mat_limma),
    rownames(ext_meta)
  )
)
# ============================================================
# 22. LOG2 TRANSFORMATION
# ============================================================
ext_mat_log <- ext_mat_limma
for (i in seq_len(
  nrow(ext_mat_log)
)) {

  x <- as.numeric(
    ext_mat_log[i, ]
  )

  positive <- x[
    is.finite(x) &
      x > 0
  ]

  if (length(positive) == 0) {

    ext_mat_log[i, ] <- NA_real_

    next
  }

  half_min <- min(
    positive
  ) / 2

  x[
    !is.finite(x) |
      x <= 0
  ] <- half_min

  ext_mat_log[i, ] <- log2(
    x
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 23. REMOVE ZERO-VARIANCE FEATURES
# ============================================================
feature_sd <- apply(
  ext_mat_log,
  1,
  sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
ext_mat_log <- ext_mat_log[
  is.finite(feature_sd) &
    feature_sd > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(ext_mat_log) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No variable lipid features remain."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 24. FACTORS
# ============================================================
ext_meta$Sex <- factor(
  ext_meta$Sex
)
ext_meta$Steatosis <- factor(
  ext_meta$Steatosis,
  levels = c(
    0,
    1
  )
)
# ============================================================
# 25. LIMMA DESIGN
# ============================================================
design_ext <- model.matrix(
  ~ Age + BMI + Sex + Steatosis,
  data = ext_meta
)
coef_name <- "Steatosis1"
if (!coef_name %in%
    colnames(design_ext)
) {

  stop(
    "Steatosis1 coefficient not found."
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 26. LIMMA
# ============================================================
fit_ext <- lmFit(
  ext_mat_log,
  design_ext
)
fit_ext <- eBayes(
  fit_ext
)
# ============================================================
# 27. EXTERNAL RESULTS
# ============================================================
res_ext <- topTable(
  fit_ext,
  coef = coef_name,
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "none"
)
res_ext$Feature <- rownames(
  res_ext
)
# ============================================================
# 28. EXTERNAL SIGNIFICANT RESULTS
# ============================================================
res_ext_sig <- res_ext %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(adj.P.Val),
    adj.P.Val <= 0.10,
    !is.na(logFC)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    External_Direction = ifelse(
      logFC > 0,
      "Up",
      "Down"
    )
  )
# ============================================================
# 29. CANONICAL LIPID MATCHING
# ============================================================
canonical_lipid <- function(x) {

  x <- toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )

  # Remove class prefixes
  x <- gsub(
    "^(FATTY_ACIDS_EICOSANOIDS|STEROLS|PRENOLS_CARDIOLIPINS|NEUTRAL_LIPIDS|SPHINGOLIPIDS|PHOSPHOLIPIDS)\\.",
    "",
    x
  )

  # Remove spaces
  x <- gsub(
    "\\s+",
    "",
    x
  )

  # Keep lipid-relevant characters
  x <- gsub(
    "[^A-Z0-9:/(),+_-]",
    "",
    x
  )

  x
}
# ============================================================
# 30. MATCH IDs
# ============================================================
int_steatosis$Match_ID <- canonical_lipid(
  int_steatosis$Lipid
)
res_ext$Match_ID <- canonical_lipid(
  res_ext$Feature
)
res_ext_sig$Match_ID <- canonical_lipid(
  res_ext_sig$Feature
)
# ============================================================
# 31. MATCH INTERNAL SIGNIFICANT LIPIDS
# ============================================================
matched <- int_steatosis %>%
  inner_join(
    res_ext %>%
      select(
        Match_ID,
        External_Feature = Feature,
        External_logFC = logFC,
        External_FDR = adj.P.Val
      ),
    by = "Match_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    External_Direction = ifelse(
      External_logFC > 0,
      "Up",
      "Down"
    ),
    Direction = ifelse(
      Internal_Direction ==
        External_Direction,
      "Same",
      "Opposite"
    ),
    External_Significant =
      !is.na(External_FDR) &
      External_FDR <= 0.10
  )
# ============================================================
# 32. COUNTS
# ============================================================
n_internal <- nrow(
  int_steatosis
)
n_internal_up <- sum(
  int_steatosis$Internal_Direction ==
    "Up"
)
n_internal_down <- sum(
  int_steatosis$Internal_Direction ==
    "Down"
)
n_external_sig <- nrow(
  res_ext_sig
)
n_external_up <- sum(
  res_ext_sig$External_Direction ==
    "Up"
)
n_external_down <- sum(
  res_ext_sig$External_Direction ==
    "Down"
)
n_matched <- nrow(
  matched
)
n_same <- sum(
  matched$Direction ==
    "Same"
)
n_opposite <- sum(
  matched$Direction ==
    "Opposite"
)
n_same_up <- sum(
  matched$Internal_Direction == "Up" &
    matched$External_Direction == "Up"
)
n_same_down <- sum(
  matched$Internal_Direction == "Down" &
    matched$External_Direction == "Down"
)
n_opposite_up_down <- sum(
  matched$Internal_Direction == "Up" &
    matched$External_Direction == "Down"
)
n_opposite_down_up <- sum(
  matched$Internal_Direction == "Down" &
    matched$External_Direction == "Up"
)
n_external_sig_matched <- sum(
  matched$External_Significant
)
n_not_measured <- n_internal -
  n_matched
# ============================================================
# 33. CONCORDANCE
# ============================================================
concordance_pct <- ifelse(
  n_matched > 0,
  100 * n_same / n_matched,
  NA_real_
)
# ============================================================
# 34. SPEARMAN CORRELATION
# ============================================================
if (n_matched >= 3) {

  spearman_test <- cor.test(
    matched$Internal_logFC,
    matched$External_logFC,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  spearman_rho <- unname(
    spearman_test$estimate
  )

  spearman_p <- spearman_test$p.value

} else {

  spearman_rho <- NA_real_
  spearman_p <- NA_real_
}
# ============================================================
# 35. FINAL TABLE
# ============================================================
final_concordance <- data.frame(

  Phenotype =
    "Steatosis",

  External_Contrast =
    "Normal vs Steatosis/NASH/Cirrhosis",

  External_Model =
    "Age + BMI + Sex + Steatosis",

  External_N =
    nrow(ext_meta),

  Same_Up =

  Opposite_Up_to_Down =

  Concordance_Percent =

    ),

  Matched_External_Significant =
    n_external_sig_matched,

  Not_Measured_Externally =
    n_not_measured,

  Spearman_Rho =
    round(
      spearman_rho,
      4
    ),

  Spearman_P =
    format.pval(
      spearman_p,
      digits = 4,
      eps = 1e-300
    ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# ============================================================
# 36. ONLY PRINT FINAL RESULT
# ============================================================
print(
  final_concordance,
  row.names = FALSE
)
# ============================================================
# ST000915 STEATOSIS VALIDATION
# NORMAL vs STEATOSIS ONLY
# ============================================================
library(writexl)
# ============================================================
# 1. EXTERNAL RESULTS
# ============================================================
# res_ext ALREADY contains "Feature"
external_st <- res_ext %>%
    mutate(
        External_ID = canonical_lipid(Feature),
        External_logFC = logFC,
        External_FDR = adj.P.Val,
        External_Direction = case_when(
            logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
            logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
            TRUE ~ "No change"
        )
    )
# ============================================================
# 2. INTERNAL DISCOVERY RESULTS
#    Steatosis, FDR ≤ 0.10
# ============================================================
discovery_st <- my_results %>%
    filter(
        Phenotype == "Steatosis",
        !is.na(adj.P.Val),
        adj.P.Val <= 0.10
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        Discovery_ID = canonical_lipid(`Lipid main ID`),
        Discovery_logFC = logFC,
        Discovery_FDR = adj.P.Val,
        Discovery_Direction = Direction
    )
# ============================================================
# 3. MATCH INTERNAL DISCOVERY TO ST000915
# ============================================================
matched <- discovery_st %>%
    left_join(
        external_st %>%
            select(
                External_ID,
                Feature,
                External_logFC,
                External_FDR,
                External_Direction
            ),
        by = c("Discovery_ID" = "External_ID")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        Measured_externally = !is.na(External_logFC),
        Direction_concordant = case_when(
            !Measured_externally ~ NA,
            Discovery_logFC > 0 & External_logFC > 0 ~ TRUE,
            Discovery_logFC < 0 & External_logFC < 0 ~ TRUE,
            TRUE ~ FALSE
        )
    )
# ============================================================
# 4. TABLE S14A
#    VALIDATION SUMMARY
# ============================================================
discovery_n <- nrow(discovery_st)
external_sig_n <- sum(
    matched$Measured_externally &
        matched$External_FDR <= 0.10,
    na.rm = TRUE
)
measured_n <- sum(
    matched$Measured_externally,
    na.rm = TRUE
)
same_n <- sum(
    matched$Direction_concordant == TRUE,
    na.rm = TRUE
)
opposite_n <- sum(
    matched$Direction_concordant == FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
)
concordance_pct <- ifelse(
    measured_n > 0,
    100 * same_n / measured_n,
    NA_real_
)
Table_S14A <- data.frame(
    Phenotype = "Steatosis",
    Contrast = "Normal vs Steatosis",

)
cat("\n================ TABLE S14A ================\n")
print(Table_S14A, row.names = FALSE)
# ============================================================
# 5. TABLE S14B
#    FEATURE-LEVEL VALIDATION
# ============================================================
Table_S14B <- matched %>%
    transmute(
        Phenotype = Phenotype,

    ) %>%
    arrange(
        desc(Measuredexternally),

    )
cat("\n================ TABLE S14B ================\n")
print(Table_S14B, row.names = FALSE)
# ============================================================
# 6. SANITY CHECK
# ============================================================
cat("\n================ SANITY CHECK ================\n")
cat(
    "Discovery-significant lipids:",
    discovery_n,
    "\n"
)
cat(
    "Measured externally:",
    measured_n,
    "\n"
)
cat(
    "External significant:",
    external_sig_n,

)
cat(
    "Same direction:",
    same_n,
    "\n"
)
cat(
    "Opposite direction:",
    opposite_n,
    "\n"
)
cat(
    "Percent concordant:",
    round(concordance_pct, 2),
    "%\n"
)

```
